005package org.wpilib.math.controller;
006
007import org.ejml.simple.SimpleMatrix;
008import org.wpilib.math.linalg.DARE;
009import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Matrix;
010import org.wpilib.math.linalg.Vector;
011import org.wpilib.math.numbers.N1;
012import org.wpilib.math.system.Discretization;
013import org.wpilib.math.system.LinearSystem;
014import org.wpilib.math.util.Num;
015import org.wpilib.math.util.StateSpaceUtil;
016import org.wpilib.util.UsageReporting;
017
018/**
019 * Contains the controller coefficients and logic for a linear-quadratic regulator (LQR). LQRs use
020 * the control law u = K(r - x).
021 *
022 * <p>For more on the underlying math, read <a
023 * href="https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf">https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf</a>.
024 *
025 * @param <States> Number of states.
026 * @param <Inputs> Number of inputs.
027 * @param <Outputs> Number of outputs.
028 */
029public class LinearQuadraticRegulator<States extends Num, Inputs extends Num, Outputs extends Num> {
030  /** The current reference state. */
031  private Matrix<States, N1> m_r;
032
033  /** The computed and capped controller output. */
034  private Matrix<Inputs, N1> m_u;
035
036  /** The error at the time of the last controller update. */
037  private Matrix<States, N1> m_error;
038
039  /** The error which is considered tolerable for use with atReference(). */
040  private Matrix<States, N1> m_tolerance;
041
042  // Controller gain.
043  private Matrix<Inputs, States> m_K;
044
045  /**
046   * Constructs a controller with the given coefficients and plant. Rho is defaulted to 1.
047   *
048   * <p>See <a
049   * href="https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning">https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning</a>
050   * for how to select the tolerances.
051   *
052   * @param plant The plant being controlled.
053   * @param qelms The maximum desired error tolerance for each state.
054   * @param relms The maximum desired control effort for each input.
055   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
056   * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the system is unstabilizable.
057   */
058  public LinearQuadraticRegulator(
059      LinearSystem<States, Inputs, Outputs> plant,
060      Vector<States> qelms,
061      Vector<Inputs> relms,
062      double dt) {
063    this(
064        plant.getA(),
065        plant.getB(),
066        StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(qelms),
067        StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(relms),
068        dt);
069  }
070
071  /**
072   * Constructs a controller with the given coefficients and plant.
073   *
074   * <p>See <a
075   * href="https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning">https://docs.wpilib.org/en/stable/docs/software/advanced-controls/state-space/state-space-intro.html#lqr-tuning</a>
076   * for how to select the tolerances.
077   *
078   * @param A Continuous system matrix of the plant being controlled.
079   * @param B Continuous input matrix of the plant being controlled.
080   * @param qelms The maximum desired error tolerance for each state.
081   * @param relms The maximum desired control effort for each input.
082   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
083   * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the system is unstabilizable.
084   */
085  public LinearQuadraticRegulator(
086      Matrix<States, States> A,
087      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
088      Vector<States> qelms,
089      Vector<Inputs> relms,
090      double dt) {
091    this(A, B, StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(qelms), StateSpaceUtil.costMatrix(relms), dt);
092  }
093
094  /**
095   * Constructs a controller with the given coefficients and plant.
096   *
097   * @param A Continuous system matrix of the plant being controlled.
098   * @param B Continuous input matrix of the plant being controlled.
099   * @param Q The state cost matrix.
100   * @param R The input cost matrix.
101   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
102   * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the system is unstabilizable.
103   */
104  public LinearQuadraticRegulator(
105      Matrix<States, States> A,
106      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
107      Matrix<States, States> Q,
108      Matrix<Inputs, Inputs> R,
109      double dt) {
110    var discABPair = Discretization.discretizeAB(A, B, dt);
111    var discA = discABPair.getFirst();
112    var discB = discABPair.getSecond();
113
114    var S = DARE.dare(discA, discB, Q, R);
115
116    // K = (BᵀSB + R)⁻¹BᵀSA
117    m_K =
118        discB
119            .transpose()
120            .times(S)
121            .times(discB)
122            .plus(R)
123            .solve(discB.transpose().times(S).times(discA));
124
125    m_r = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumRows(), 1));
126    m_u = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumCols(), 1));
127    m_error = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumRows(), 1));
128    m_tolerance = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumRows(), 1));
129
130    reset();
131    UsageReporting.reportUsage("LinearQuadraticRegulator", "");
132  }
133
134  /**
135   * Constructs a controller with the given coefficients and plant.
136   *
137   * @param A Continuous system matrix of the plant being controlled.
138   * @param B Continuous input matrix of the plant being controlled.
139   * @param Q The state cost matrix.
140   * @param R The input cost matrix.
141   * @param N The state-input cross-term cost matrix.
142   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
143   * @throws IllegalArgumentException If the system is unstabilizable.
144   */
145  public LinearQuadraticRegulator(
146      Matrix<States, States> A,
147      Matrix<States, Inputs> B,
148      Matrix<States, States> Q,
149      Matrix<Inputs, Inputs> R,
150      Matrix<States, Inputs> N,
151      double dt) {
152    var discABPair = Discretization.discretizeAB(A, B, dt);
153    var discA = discABPair.getFirst();
154    var discB = discABPair.getSecond();
155
156    var S = DARE.dare(discA, discB, Q, R, N);
157
158    // K = (BᵀSB + R)⁻¹(BᵀSA + Nᵀ)
159    m_K =
160        discB
161            .transpose()
162            .times(S)
163            .times(discB)
164            .plus(R)
165            .solve(discB.transpose().times(S).times(discA).plus(N.transpose()));
166
167    m_r = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumRows(), 1));
168    m_u = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumCols(), 1));
169    m_error = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumRows(), 1));
170    m_tolerance = new Matrix<>(new SimpleMatrix(B.getNumRows(), 1));
171
172    reset();
173    UsageReporting.reportUsage("LinearQuadraticRegulator", "");
174  }
175
176  /**
177   * Returns the control input vector u.
178   *
179   * @return The control input.
180   */
181  public Matrix<Inputs, N1> getU() {
182    return m_u;
183  }
184
185  /**
186   * Returns an element of the control input vector u.
187   *
188   * @param row Row of u.
189   * @return The row of the control input vector.
190   */
191  public double getU(int row) {
192    return m_u.get(row, 0);
193  }
194
195  /**
196   * Returns the reference vector r.
197   *
198   * @return The reference vector.
199   */
200  public Matrix<States, N1> getR() {
201    return m_r;
202  }
203
204  /**
205   * Returns an element of the reference vector r.
206   *
207   * @param row Row of r.
208   * @return The row of the reference vector.
209   */
210  public double getR(int row) {
211    return m_r.get(row, 0);
212  }
213
214  /**
215   * Returns the controller matrix K.
216   *
217   * @return the controller matrix K.
218   */
219  public Matrix<Inputs, States> getK() {
220    return m_K;
221  }
222
223  /** Resets the controller. */
224  public final void reset() {
225    m_r.fill(0.0);
226    m_u.fill(0.0);
227    m_error.fill(0.0);
228  }
229
230  /**
231   * Returns true if the error is within the tolerance set by setTolerance() for every state.
232   *
233   * @return True if the error is within tolerance of the reference.
234   */
235  public boolean atReference() {
236    for (int i = 0; i < m_error.getNumRows(); i++) {
237      if (Math.abs(m_error.get(i, 0)) > m_tolerance.get(i, 0)) {
238        return false;
239      }
240    }
241    return true;
242  }
243
244  /**
245   * Sets the error which is considered tolerable for use with atReference().
246   *
247   * @param tolerance The tolerable error for each state.
248   */
249  public void setTolerance(Matrix<States, N1> tolerance) {
250    m_tolerance = tolerance;
251  }
252
253  /**
254   * Returns the next output of the controller.
255   *
256   * @param x The current state x.
257   * @return The next controller output.
258   */
259  public Matrix<Inputs, N1> calculate(Matrix<States, N1> x) {
260    m_error = m_r.minus(x);
261    m_u = m_K.times(m_error);
262    return m_u;
263  }
264
265  /**
266   * Returns the next output of the controller.
267   *
268   * @param x The current state x.
269   * @param nextR the next reference vector r.
270   * @return The next controller output.
271   */
272  public Matrix<Inputs, N1> calculate(Matrix<States, N1> x, Matrix<States, N1> nextR) {
273    m_r = nextR;
274    return calculate(x);
275  }
276
277  /**
278   * Adjusts LQR controller gain to compensate for a pure time delay in the input.
279   *
280   * <p>Linear-Quadratic regulator controller gains tend to be aggressive. If sensor measurements
281   * are time-delayed too long, the LQR may be unstable. However, if we know the amount of delay, we
282   * can compute the control based on where the system will be after the time delay.
283   *
284   * <p>See <a
285   * href="https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf">https://file.tavsys.net/control/controls-engineering-in-frc.pdf</a>
286   * appendix C.4 for a derivation.
287   *
288   * @param plant The plant being controlled.
289   * @param dt Discretization timestep in seconds.
290   * @param inputDelay Input time delay in seconds.
291   */
292  public void latencyCompensate(
293      LinearSystem<States, Inputs, Outputs> plant, double dt, double inputDelay) {
294    var discABPair = Discretization.discretizeAB(plant.getA(), plant.getB(), dt);
295    var discA = discABPair.getFirst();
296    var discB = discABPair.getSecond();
297
298    m_K = m_K.times((discA.minus(discB.times(m_K))).pow(inputDelay / dt));
299  }
300}
